fixed: medium/375+393: DIREKTE NÅ 'Saint Louis Rapid & Blitz 2026' live-now title wrapped one word per line because the nowrap channel label '.live-meta' claimed its full natural width and squeezed the title column
notes: Root cause (docs/css/cards.css .live-item): .live-meta was white-space:nowrap with margin-left:auto, giving it a min-content floor at the full channel-label width, while .live-body (min-width:0) shrank fully — so a long channel label ('YouTube (Saint Louis Chess Club) +1') starved the title into a narrow left column.

Fix: .live-body gets flex:1 1 auto so the title claims available row width; .live-meta gets flex:0 1 auto, min-width:0, max-width:42%, text-align:right, overflow-wrap:anywhere so a long channel label wraps within a bounded right column instead of monopolising the row.

Verified by screenshot at 375/393/900: title now fills its column (one line at 375, two full-width lines at 393), channel label wraps neatly on the right; 900px unchanged (ample room). No regressions to header/agenda/live/footer.
